'''Unit 7860''' was a textile mill located on [[Quadrant T-15]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During [[Republic Treasury/Legends|Republic Treasury]] agent [[Besany Wennen]]'s investigation on [[Dhannut Logistics]], she learned that their office was supposedly based on that building but was not.<ref name="tc">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref>
